scope: Actual platform published snapshot, direct Wren SDK with MySQL; not chat E2E.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_cents)/100.0 AS revenue_yuan FROM valid_order
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS paying_customers FROM valid_order
SELECT customer_name,SUM(amount_cents)/100.0 AS revenue_yuan FROM valid_order GROUP BY customer_id,customer_name ORDER BY revenue_yuan DESC
SELECT SUM(net_cents)/100.0 AS net_revenue_yuan FROM order_net_revenue
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count,SUM(value_cents)/100.0 AS event_value_yuan FROM event
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_count FROM "order" o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
SELECT product_code,COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM product GROUP BY product_code HAVING COUNT(*)>1
